note: Kenya's 290 sub-counties are coterminous with its National Assembly constituencies and Wikidata types them as constituencies only. The electoral demotion, right for the 19 countries it was added for, left the country with 2 municipalities.
Namibia's 121 constituencies are the administrative unit below the region, not a voting map drawn over one. Without this the level came out as 20 cities.

The level is the 12 provinces. The harvest also returns the 3 Caribbean public entities (Bonaire, Saba, Sint Eustatius), which are part of the Netherlands but of no province; ISO 3166 gives them their own country code, BQ, so they are not this country's level 2.

The level is the 342 municipalities. The harvest also returns 19 water boards (hoogheemraadschappen), which manage dykes and water quality over their own territory and are not units of general government, the same error as the UAE's free economic zones. With the ended-type rule the class itself is clean at 343.

The province class gives mainland China's 31 province-level divisions (22 provinces, 5 autonomous regions, 4 municipalities) and leaves out Hong Kong and Macau, which the spine holds and which the 2026-09-23 decision keeps. The special administrative region class contains exactly those two, so keeping it beside the dominant one restores the spine's 33. Taiwan is handled separately, in the unit-exclusions file, because that is a decision rather than a class.

The level is the 37 divisions. The dominant class came out as union council, a tier far below, because Pakistan has 85 of those in Wikidata against 37 divisions, and the classes above them in the harvest are all electoral: constituencies of four provincial assemblies and of the National Assembly. Six of the 37 divisions sit in Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan, which the unit-exclusions file keeps out of level 2, so those divisions lose their parent and drop with them.

The level is China's 333 prefecture-level divisions, which are two classes: 307 prefecture-level cities and 33 autonomous prefectures. Wikidata's dominant class here is 'fourth-level administrative division' with 1,867 members, a whole tier below the spine's 364 prefectures. The seven plain prefectures and three leagues are not separately carried and are the shortfall against 333.

The level is the 290 municipalities. The harvest also returns 34 medieval hundreds, 21 historical landskap provinces and 19 regional councils, three tiers the sibling rule admitted beside the right one. Sweden was never the abolished-units case its ledger note claimed: the class measured clean at exactly 290.
